'''''Dayta 1''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] that was carrying workers following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. It arrived, along with [[Onece group]] at [[Outpost D-34]] in the [[Javin system/Legends|Javin system]], requesting permission to pass through the sector. [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] inspected Dayta 1 and [[Dayta 2|2]] to find no contraband in the transports, so both transports were allowed to leave. However in [[Onece 3]] there were rebels hidden on the freighter resulting in the [[Skirmish at Outpost D-34]].
